name: documind-ai
description: Full-Stack RAG Document Assistant using Google Gemini and Supabase

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@documind/shared && npm run build --workspace=@documind/api && npm run build --workspace=@documind/web
scripts.lint: eslint scripts eslint.config.mjs prisma.config.ts --max-warnings=0 && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@documind/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@documind/shared && npm run test:tooling && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run prisma:validate
